_doc: /whatsnew and /tour (ADR 0130): today's additions in tour order. Any lane appends an entry: id (one word, /tour <id>), title, what (one or two sentences: what to look for), run (command lines a click or /tour runs, in order; may be empty), date. test_whats_new.gd checks every line is a known command with valid arguments.

entries.title: Quality of life
entries.what: F7 marks dark ground red (yellow: dark at night), hold Z to zoom, F1 hides the HUD, Alt + wheel swaps hotbar rows, middle click sorts, Craft in the recipe view. /home brings you back here.

entries.title: Six LV machines
entries.what: Extractor (rubber from logs), cutter, extruder, canning machine, compressor and electrolyzer on a powered line, with the electric kit to feed them.

entries.title: Electricity in real units
entries.what: A 48 V DC circuit: look at a cable or hold the multimeter for volts, amps and watts. The kit has a knife switch, a fuse box and a breaker; overload a cable and it burns.

entries.title: Wooden lookouts
entries.what: A log tower with a plank platform 5.5 m up, a new ruin kind for the woods. Climb it and look for its pots underneath.

entries.title: Abandoned mines, lined
entries.what: The mine's head-frame and decline now sit on a timber lining, nothing hangs in the air.

entries.title: Dune grass and gulls
entries.what: Clumps of dune grass above the tide line; gulls land along the coast and mackerel shoal in the sea.

entries.title: Heather and goats
entries.what: Heather carpets in the highlands and scrub; goats climb to the alpine and the peaks.

entries.title: Tundra sedge, snow hares, ptarmigan
entries.what: Sparse sedge through the tundra snow, and the frozen biomes have animals now.

entries.title: Desert life
entries.what: Lizards, scorpions (they sting with poison) and vultures overhead.

entries.title: Antelope herds
entries.what: Antelope on the savanna, shrubland and badlands, lizards underfoot.

entries.title: Parrots
entries.what: Parrots perch in the jungle and mangrove.

entries.title: Magma salamanders
entries.what: Salamanders live in magma and sulfur caves. Mind the lava.

entries.title: A still lake stays still
entries.what: Arriving at a lake no longer wakes the water: F3 should show the sim quiet and frames smooth. Dig a pit at the shore: it still fills.

entries.title: Steam is white again
entries.what: Steam no longer draws brown against the sky. /count steam says how many cells the sim holds.

entries.title: Sleeves on body clothing
entries.what: Worn body clothing has sleeves: F5 for the third-person view, or see the inventory portrait (E).

entries.title: Real volts and small power
entries.what: The LV network runs on volts, amps and watts now (ADR 0123). A water wheel, a wind turbine and a hand crank feed a meter panel, a fuse, a battery and two lamps behind a daylight switch; the multimeter reads any piece. Watch the meter's bars and the lamps come on at night.
